svg.title: SimLM tier 1 with document processing
svg.desc: Offline, an LLM reads source documents and produces Q&A pairs that an admin reviews before they enter the Postgres pattern store. At runtime, a normalized message falls through four SQL tiers; first hit returns a reply, all miss returns a fallback.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I split docs into sections first?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM generate Q&A pairs from a doc?')
sendPrompt('What does admin review check before import?')
sendPrompt('What is the schema of the pattern store?')
sendPrompt('How is the incoming message normalized?')
sendPrompt('How does the exact tier match?')
sendPrompt('How does Postgres FTS match at tier 3?')
sendPrompt('How is a reply selected once a tier hits?')
sendPrompt('What is returned when all tiers miss?')
